card.name: Ordinals before hyphenated compounds
card.fires_on: Ordinal words such as second, third, first or fifth that start a compound like second-class, third-party or first-hand. It fires where a hyphen and a noun are expected next.

modes.label: Second/third before hyphen
modes.description: An ordinal begins a hyphenated compound adjective.

modes.label: Ordinal before a noun
modes.description: An ordinal directly modifies a noun such as party, object or graders.

card.writes: It promotes words like century, generation and tier, which are the usual continuations of an ordinal-style compound.
card.plain: It marks an ordinal such as second or third that is the first half of a compound like third-party or second-hand.
